findings: Input reads restricted to public training NPZ and their manifest; source/test/evaluator references are not read by fitting.
75% fitting/rank and25% calibration partitions remain disjoint; nuisance exposure parameters use source-fit original300-feature counts only and remain frozen across controls/widths/bootstraps.
Column permutation controls preserve integer counts and are generated for all300 columns before prefix selection.
NB/ZI sensitivities use declared observed-mean rate units; ordinary arms retain Poisson rank calibration but use ordinary moments and empirical CF.
Constant-rate columns use working_scale1 internally while observed scale0 remains exported; rank and alignment use working scale consistently.

Bootstrap model and calibration draws are independent within assay and deterministically replayed in the same fit-then-cal order. Secondary CF uses saved bootstrap directions/means without source refits.

Secondary CF covers endpoints of all signed moment-equivalent pairs including ambiguous pairs, preserving not-assessed status elsewhere. Raw rejected CF values and numeric diagnostics are now retained for independent replay.
PGF eligibility uses the worst processing-point effective cell count; numeric bootstrap minima are saved.
All RNG draws are local seeded generators; forked workers share prepared arrays without modifying them.
Memory is bounded by feature covariance matrices, projected cubic tensors and compact bootstrap direction arrays; no p-cubic tensors or duplicated per-arm count caches.
Failures/abstentions remain explicit; no output directory overwrite, source hashes checked before final seal.
limits: Finite fingerprints and this development sweep do not establish causal identifiability or confirmatory selection guarantees.
Fixed kernel and depth sensitivities remain modeling assumptions; common300-feature proxy differs from the earlier30-feature study.
Replay validates arithmetic and provenance, not the biological truth of accepted sources.
